about_the_game:
Train your favorite characters and have them ready for the next run!

Command beautiful girls to defend the castle and princess in a non-reset roguelite × tower defense.

A roguelite-style tower defense game where the characters you’ve trained can be used again in the next run.

Stop enemy advances and command your team of beautiful girls to protect the castle and the princess.

  • Roguelite, but without resets – trained allies are ready to fight in the next run

  • 9 unique and charming female characters

  • Strategic depth through character upgrades and skill acquisition

  • Action gameplay where you move, attack, and command allies in battle

  • Experience the satisfaction of strengthening your entire party through repeated cycles of battle and growth

In traditional roguelite action games, it’s common for your progress to reset with each run.
This game breaks that convention, letting you take the allies you’ve trained in one run into the next as powerful assets.

With this “stacked growth” system, the more you play, the more reliable and powerful your favorite allies become.

How strong can your team of beautiful girls grow under your command—?
Take the power you’ve built up to the next battlefield.

content_descriptors.notes: Some characters feature outfits with mild skin exposure.
